newsitem.title: USA: Conserver in Canada joint venture.
newsitem.headline: Conserver in Canada joint venture.

text.p: Conserver Corp of America said Thursday it had signed a letter of intent to form a joint venture with the former chairman of H.J. Heinz Co of Canada Ltd to distribute its Conserver 21 product in Canada.
Conserver said in a news release that it would own 51 percent of the venture, to be called Conserver Corp of Canada, and would fund certain of its expenses.
Conserver's partner in the venture is Thomas Smyth, who will serve as venture chairman. Smyth is the former longtime chairman and president of Heinz of Canada.
Conserver 21 is a product that extends the life of fruits, vegetables and flowers by cleansing harmful gases in packaging, storage or transport containers.
